verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair question for a hosted AI API provider, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a way to pick a storage region or residency for DeepSeek API data. One community comment says hosted data goes to China, which describes a location, not a user choice. Self-hosting the open weights would be a user-side workaround, not a product residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
